en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a tranquil pond surrounded by dense trees. On the left is a simple wooden footbridge spanning a narrow part of the water, its reflection visible below. On the right stands a small wooden hut or duck house on the water's edge, next to which a single white swan is visible. The image has a soft, slightly faded look typical of early 20th‑century landscape postcards. No printed captions or visible handwriting appear on the image side.
